title: OEIS
description: Documented public integer sequence database (Neil Sloane / OEIS Foundation) for the Experimental Mathematics Laboratory capability area.
body:
OEIS is a documented integer sequence database from Neil Sloane / OEIS Foundation. The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences: 370,000+ sequences that let experimental mathematicians identify patterns in computed data.

How it works: It works by tokenizing the query and scoring each knowledge-base row on term overlap, returning the match count and top hits.

Documented uses of this capability area include discovering physical laws from experimental data, verifying mathematical proofs, quantifying simulation uncertainty, and calibrating models to measurements.

title: SageMath
description: Documented public open mathematics system (SageMath community (open source)) for the Experimental Mathematics Laboratory capability area.
body:
SageMath is a documented open mathematics system from SageMath community (open source). Open-source environment unifying dozens of math packages, the workhorse for computational exploration of conjectures.

How it works: It works by generating noisy data from a hidden quadratic law, then solving the normal equations by least squares to recover the coefficients, reporting R-squared as the fit quality.

Documented uses of this capability area include discovering physical laws from experimental data, verifying mathematical proofs, quantifying simulation uncertainty, and calibrating models to measurements.
